turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Heard them. You haven't answered either one.
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
Then show me the facts. I'm still waiting on who decided, and when.
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
Owen doesn't lie, and you've just accused him without showing me a single document. Is that how you'll say it in the principal's office, because that's where this is going next.
